function.description: Get field notice scan summary for one network device by device id. User-facing answers must not show raw networkDeviceId values unless the user explicitly asks for internal UUIDs. If presenting the device name or management IP, call get_device_details with device_id set to the exact networkDeviceId; do not call get_device_details without device_id or use the first device from a generic device list.
function.name: api_getFieldNoticeNetworkDeviceByDeviceId

comments.description: More details about the scan status. ie:- if the scan status is failed, comments will give the reason for failure

lastScanTime.description: Time at which the device was scanned

networkDeviceId.description: Internal device UUID for backend lookup only. Do not present this raw value in user-facing output. Use get_device_details with device_id set to this exact UUID to resolve device name and management IP.

noticeCount.description: Number of confirmed field notices to which the network device is vulnerable.

potentialNoticeCount.description: Number of potential field notices to which the network device may be vulnerable. Do not include this value in final answers unless the user explicitly asks for potential field notices.

scanStatus.description: 'NOT_SCANNED' - the device was not scanned. 'IN_PROGRESS' - a scan is in progress for the device. 'SUCCESS' - device scan was successful. 'FAILED' - device scan failed
